battle.name: 宋平丁進之戰
battle.brief: 建炎元年，壽春人丁進在蘇村聚眾萬數，自稱丁一箭，十一月圍壽春二十五日不克；東京留守宗澤招納其眾屯於京師，宗澤病逝後再叛，劉正彥、劉晏統三千精兵會八百騎兵迫降。維京長斧這類雙手長刃斧不見於本役記載，只可作步戰砍劈冷兵器形制上的比照。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 交戰一方是南宋朝廷。建炎元年五月高宗即位于南京應天府，行在兵柄分屬樞密院與京師留守司，淮南一線的軍事由東京留守宗澤節制，御營則掌握在御營諸軍手中；江淮之間的糧運與治安則倚仗漕運和鎮淮各軍的駐屯。另一方是起於淮南的叛軍，首領丁進本是壽春人，在蘇村聚眾萬餘，自稱「丁一箭」，面上刺六點或「入火」二字以為記號，部眾多屬無籍流民、潰兵與鄉野壯丁，既無建制名號，也無穩定給養。叛軍一度圍住壽春，州守康允之率守軍閉城拒守，朝廷遣使招撫之後由宗澤收納，授其「京城四壁外巡」之職，部眾屯於東京城外；宗澤病逝之後叛眾再叛，轉攻淮西，終由御營右軍副統制劉正彥與劉晏所部進剿。戰場之外，金人仍據河北與山東，是這批叛眾一度想引為外援的第三方，也牽制著南宋在淮上的所有調度。
countriesEn: The Song side was the Southern Song court. In the fifth month of 1127 the emperor took the throne at Nanjing Yingtian fu, and the military authority of the travelling court was split between the Bureau of Military Affairs and the office of the capital commander, while the armies of the imperial camp held the field. Along the Huai the court relied on the grain traffic of the canals and on the garrisons posted between the river and the sea. The other side was the rebel host that rose in southern Huai. Its leader, Ding Jin, was a native of Shouchun; at Sucun he gathered a following of more than ten thousand men, called himself 'Ding the First Arrow', and had the faces of his followers marked with six dots or with the two characters 'enter the fire'. His men were in the main landless refugees, routed soldiers and village strongmen, with no regular units and no dependable supply. For a time they besieged Shouchun, whose prefect Kang Yunzhi shut the gates and held the city; envoys went out from the court, and then Zong Ze, commander of the capital, took the rebel host into his command, gave it the post of 'outer patrol of the four quarters of the capital', and quartered the men outside Dongjing. After Zong Ze's death the rebels rose once more and turned towards western Huai, where they were finally put down by the imperial camp under Liu Zhengyan and Liu Yan. Beyond these two armies stood the Jin, still holding Hebei and Shandong: the third party the rebels would have liked to draw in, and the power that tied down every Southern Song deployment above the Huai.
people: 核心人物是丁進。他本是淮南一介鄉里，首領，靠聚眾、刺面為記與臨陣鼓噪立起「丁一箭」的旗號；建炎元年十一月圍壽春二十五日不克，是他一生中最接近大捷的一役。決定他命運的是東京留守宗澤：先以招撫收納其眾，授外巡之職、讓部眾屯於東京，等於給可能成為敵軍的流民一條出路；宗澤七個月後病逝，主張安撫的大員隨之更替，叛眾再度嘯變。十月赴淮西平叛的是御營右軍副統制劉正彥與劉晏，兩人率三千精兵合八百騎兵，用五色旗虛張聲勢，迫叛眾請降，事後把降眾分隸諸軍。壽春守臣康允之在圍城之際賞銀帛以激士氣，保住了州城。一二九年二月丁進請率所部回江北與金人血戰，被朝廷疑為再叛，鎮江的王淵遣小校張青率五十騎誘而斬之，結束了這場延續兩年多的叛亂。
peopleEn: The central figure is Ding Jin. A man of the Huai region with no rank and no following, he built the banner of 'Ding the First Arrow' by gathering country people, marking his followers' faces and raising a noisy mob in battle. His siege of Shouchun in the eleventh month of 1127, which lasted twenty-five days without success, was the closest he came to a great victory. Zong Ze, commander of the capital, decided his fate: he first took the rebels in through amnesty, gave them a post and quartered them at Dongjing, which was in effect a way out for men who might otherwise have become an enemy; when Zong Ze died seven months later, the senior officers who had favoured pacification changed, and the rebel host mutinied again. The force sent into western Huai that October was commanded by Liu Zhengyan, deputy commander of the imperial camp's right army, and by Liu Yan; with three thousand picked troops and eight hundred horsemen they spread false banners of five colours to make the rebels think the odds hopeless, forced a surrender, and afterwards distributed the surrendered men among the various units. At Shouchun the prefect Kang Yunzhi gave out silver and silk to stiffen the garrison's resolve and saved the city. In the second month of 1129 Ding Jin asked to lead his men back across the Huai to fight the Jin with their blood; the court suspected a fresh rising, and Wang Yuan, then at Zhenjiang, sent a junior officer, Zhang Qing, with fifty horsemen to lure him out and behead him, which ended a revolt that had run for more than two years.
kits: 這場戰事裡沒有可考的北歐兵器擺在正面，兵器只有一件：維京長斧。長刃、窄斧面，柄長可雙手把握，斧背厚實、刃口外弧，是十一世紀中葉北歐斧匠的典型形制；北歐船隊帶著它上船，也帶著它上岸，登陸之後既是近身砍劈的兵器，也是砍伐舟材、清理岸地的工具。卡面把它放在宋地這場戰事裡，用意是一個形制比照：丁進之眾以鄉野器械成軍，柴斧、鋤、梃、矛與徒手雜湊成所謂萬數，攻城時砍伐木料、破門板、拆屋桁以為梯棚，靠的正是斧一類的工具；圍城二十五日不克，反映的也正是斧與工具本身的局限。宗澤收納降眾之後編為「京城四壁外巡」，用的仍是鄉兵常備的刀、槍與少量弓弩；劉正彥、劉晏的官軍則以八百騎兵為機動，步卒用長刀長槍列陣，攻城時輔以撞木、雲梯一類器械，並已有火藥填裝的毒煙炮、霹靂炮等守城火器。南北兵器譜系相去極遠，但「長刃窄面、雙手揮砍」這一路形制，在北陸的船隊與淮上的鄉眾手裡，走的是同一條由工具到兵器的路。
kitsEn: No Norse weapon that can be verified stands in the foreground of this war; the weapon is one: the Dane axe. A long blade on a narrow axe head, with a haft long enough for two hands, a thick poll and an outward-curving edge, it is the classic shape produced by Norse axe-smiths in the middle of the eleventh century. The northern fleets carried it aboard their ships and carried it ashore; once landed, it was both a close-combat chopping weapon and a tool for felling timber and clearing the ground. The card sets this weapon in the Song land of this war as a formal comparison: Ding Jin's host was raised from country gear, and axes, hoes, clubs, spears and bare hands made up the so-called ten thousand; besieging a city, they felled timber, broke door boards and pulled apart roof beams to make ladders and sheds, and it was axes that did that work. The twenty-five fruitless days around Shouchun show exactly the limit of the axe when it remains a tool. Once Zong Ze had taken the rebels in and set them to patrolling the four quarters of the capital, they were armed as village levies: knives, spears and a few bows. The court force under Liu Zhengyan and Liu Yan rested its mobility on eight hundred horsemen, matched them with infantry drawn up behind long knives and long spears, and for the attack on the city used such things as battering beams and scaling ladders; it also had, for the defence of walls, fire weapons charged with gunpowder, such as the smoke bomb and the thunder crash bomb. Northern and southern weapon traditions lay far apart, yet the form of a long narrow blade swung with two hands follows the same road in the hands of a northern crew and of a Huai country mob: the road from tool to weapon.
tactics: 叛軍的戰法很粗疏：先以聚眾立旗、刺面為記造聲勢，再挑城池下手，用圍城斷援、圍而不拖的老法子熬守軍，二十五日不下便退，走的是流寇路數，不講陣形也不講攻堅器械。守方康允之閉城拒守，靠城垣、濠溝、拒馬與弓弩分層拒守，並用賞銀帛的方式穩住人心，官軍援兵在外則能以騎制敵。朝廷的處置分兩步：宗澤在時是招撫，授職、收編、屯駐，把兵禍化於無形；宗澤死後則改用進剿，御營以精兵為主力、以騎兵會合，先用疑兵之計奪其志，再迫其請降，受降之後把降眾分隸諸軍，等於把一次叛亂變成一次擴編。王淵最後處置丁進近乎突襲：遣小校張青率五十騎誘斬，說明官軍已熟悉叛眾首領的行蹤與部伍，仍須用詐術而非正規戰。糧秣方面，叛眾屯東京時靠就地取給與京畿鄉兵的糧料，進取淮西則完全倚賴淮上舟師與漕運線的支撐；官軍自東南沿水路進兵，這在秋冬的淮北水網與泥濘道路上，決定了機動與補給都要靠船。
tacticsEn: The rebels fought crudely. They first manufactured a show of force by gathering a crowd, raising a banner and marking faces, and then picked a walled city to attack, using the old method of blockade and cutting the relief road, holding the city without storming it; when twenty-five days produced nothing they withdrew, the way a roaming band does, caring neither for formation nor for siege engines. The defenders, under Kang Yunzhi, held the city with walls, ditch, spiked barriers and bows and crossbows disposed in layers, and kept the garrison's heart up with rewards of silver and silk; a court relief army outside could use its horse against the besiegers. The court's handling of the rising had two stages. Under Zong Ze it was amnesty: a post, an incorporation, a quartering, and the armed disturbance dissolved. After Zong Ze's death the policy changed to armed suppression. The imperial camp led with picked infantry and supported them with the cavalry, used a display of false strength to break the rebels' will first and only then took their surrender, and after the surrender divided the men among the various units, turning a rebellion into an expansion of the army. The last disposal of Ding Jin was close to an ambush: Wang Yuan sent the junior officer Zhang Qing with fifty horsemen to lure him to his death, which shows that the court already knew the rebel leader's movements and formations well enough still to need deception rather than a set-piece action. On the supply side, the rebels quartered at Dongjing drew on what they could take locally and on the grain of the capital's village levies; their advance into western Huai depended entirely on the boats of the Huai and on the canal grain traffic, and the court marched in from the south-east by water, so in the mud and the standing water of the winter months above the Huai, both movement and supply turned on the river.
data: 可核的數字不多，且多數見於《中國戰典》所引的記述：叛軍起事時號稱萬數；圍壽春的戰役持續二十五日；宗澤病逝於一二八年七月，叛眾再叛在九月；十月進剿的官軍為三千精兵與八百騎兵；處理丁進末事時，王淵只遣小校張青率五十騎。年月方面，起事在建炎元年即一二七年，五月高宗即位于南京應天府，八月行在遷於揚州，年底揚州失守、行在渡江；一二八、一二九兩年則見叛軍先屯東京、後攻淮西的記載。地理上，壽春即今安徽壽縣，下蔡為其舊稱，屬淮南東路；東京為汴京；淮西指淮水以西之地，與泗州、宿州一帶相接；南京應天府為宋室南渡後的行在所在。史籍對這場叛亂的兵力、糧秣與具體死傷幾乎不予記載，部眾萬數當為聚眾時的誇飾之數，諸說並存的細節亦多。以上數字皆為史載原數，此處不作推算與補齊。
dataEn: Few numbers survive, and most of them come from the account cited in the Zhongguo Zhandian. The rebel host was said to number 'more than ten thousand' when it was raised; the siege of Shouchun lasted twenty-five days; Zong Ze died in the seventh month of 1128 and the renewed rising came in the ninth month; in October the court force that attacked was three thousand picked troops and eight hundred horsemen; and when the matter of Ding Jin was closed, Wang Yuan sent only the junior officer Zhang Qing with fifty horsemen. As to dates: the rising began in the first year of Jianyan, 1127; in the fifth month the emperor took the throne at Nanjing Yingtian fu, in the eighth month the travelling court moved to Yangzhou, and at the end of the year Yangzhou fell and the court crossed the river. In 1128 and 1129 the records show the rebels first quartered at Dongjing and then marching into western Huai. In geography: Shouchun is the modern Shouxian in Anhui, Xia Cai being its older name, and it belonged to the eastern circuit of Huainan; Dongjing was Bianjing; western Huai meant the country west of the Huai water, adjoining such prefectures as Si and Su; and Nanjing Yingtian fu was the seat of the travelling court after the crossing south. The official histories record almost nothing about the strength, the supply or the casualties of this rising; the figure of ten thousand is the exaggeration of a crowd being raised, and several details remain contested. Every number above is the figure as recorded, with nothing calculated or supplied to fill the gaps.
cause: 這場叛亂不是偶然的嘩變，而是靖康之變後的連鎖反應。建炎元年五月宋室南渡，金人扶植的張邦昌在南京應天府稱帝，靖康二年二月汴京陷落，四月張邦昌被廢，高宗在應天府即位，八月遷都揚州，年底揚州又為金人所破，行在渡江。淮南一帶在極短時間內經歷了政權真空、潰兵南流、漕運中斷與人口大量南遷，京畿與淮南的鄉野之間既有對金人的恐懼，也有重返北方江淮的執念。丁進之眾起於壽春附近的蘇村，正是趁著朝廷新立、軍隊疲於奔命、招撫多而編制空缺的空檔。宗澤的招撫其實對症：給編員、給糧秣、給差事，把可能成為敵軍的流民變成巡城的力量。但招撫同時保留了原有的部伍與首領，宗澤一死，接手者改為主張鎮壓，叛眾於是再叛；可見其再度起事，既是首領個人未被妥善處置，也是淮南安置政策沒有真正落地。
causeEn: This rising was not an accidental mutiny but one link in the chain that followed the Jingkang disaster. In the fifth month of 1127 the Song court moved south, the Jin had set up Zhang Bangchang as emperor at Nanjing Yingtian fu, Bianjing fell in the second month of the second year of Jingkang, Zhang Bangchang was deposed in the fourth month, the emperor took the throne at Yingtian fu and moved the court to Yangzhou in the eighth, and by the end of the year Yangzhou too was taken and the court crossed the river. In a very short time the Huai region passed through a political vacuum, the southward drift of routed soldiers, the breaking of the grain traffic and a mass flight of population; in the villages between the capital and the Huai there lived both the fear of the Jin and a stubborn wish to return to the lost lands north of the river. Ding Jin's host rose at Sucun near Shouchun precisely in the gap left by a newly founded court, an army worn out by flight, and a policy of amnesty that offered posts without an organisation behind them. Zong Ze's amnesty was in fact a fitting answer: give them a roster, grain and a duty, and turn the people who might have been an army into a patrol. But amnesty also left the old bands and their chiefs intact; when Zong Ze died and his successor preferred suppression, the rebels rose again. Their second rising therefore shows both that the leader was never properly settled and that the settlement policy for the Huai had never actually been carried out.
impact: 從南宋立國初期的角度，這場戰事有三層意義。其一，確立了朝廷處理淮南民變的模式：先招撫、後進剿，招撫不成即分兵討平，收降之後把叛眾分隸諸軍，等於用敵人的兵源補充自己的軍隊。這套做法在隨後數年對付襄樊流民、江西盜賊時被反覆沿用，代價則是軍隊編制越來越雜、將領各自擁兵，中央對地方武裝的控制始終不暢。其二，暴露了行在兵力部署的空虛：官軍能一次調出三千精兵與八百騎兵已是極限，而壽春這樣的淮南州城，靠一位守臣的賞罰之威才守得住，說明南渡初期州府的防禦大半寄托在個人威望上。其三，在對外上，叛眾曾請率所部北上與金人血戰，其後確有部眾分隸諸軍被調往淮上與金人對峙，說明亂兵、義軍與官軍之間的界線在南渡初期本來模糊，朝廷對此既依賴又懷疑，張青誘斬丁進便是這種懷疑落到實處的一例。
impactEn: Viewed from the standpoint of the first years of the Southern Song, this war mattered on three levels. First, it fixed the court's manner of dealing with civil risings in the Huai: amnesty first, armed suppression second, and the surrendering bands distributed among the various units after the fighting, so that an enemy was turned into a source of soldiers. The same procedure was used repeatedly in the years that followed against the refugees around Xiangyang and the bandits of Jiangxi, and the price was that the army's composition grew ever more mixed and each commander kept troops of his own, so that the centre's control over local armed strength was never secure. Second, it exposed how thin the travelling court's deployments were: three thousand picked troops and eight hundred horsemen was close to the limit of what could be sent out at once, while a prefecture like Shouchun was saved by the personal authority of a single prefect playing on rewards and discipline, which shows how much of the early southern defence rested on individual reputation. Third, in foreign affairs, the rebels had asked to be led north to fight the Jin, and afterwards some of their number certainly served in court units posted above the Huai against the Jin. The line between rebels, volunteers and regulars was thus blurred in the early southern period, and the court both relied on that and mistrusted it; the beheading of Ding Jin through Zhang Qing is this mistrust carried out in a single act.
result: 結局分三段。建炎元年十一月，叛軍圍壽春二十五日不能下，隨即退走，這一役沒有分出勝負。朝廷改用招撫，宗澤收納其眾，授「京城四壁外巡」之職，部眾屯於東京，叛亂在形式上結束。一二八年七月宗澤病逝，叛眾九月再叛並攻淮西；十月劉正彥與劉晏率三千精兵會八百騎兵赴淮西，以五色旗張疑兵，迫其請降，受降之後部眾分隸諸軍，攻勢平定。一二九年二月，丁進請率所部回江北與金人血戰，被朝廷疑為再叛，鎮江的王淵遣小校張青率五十騎誘而斬之，首領伏誅，餘眾或編或散，這場延續兩年多的淮南叛亂才告一段落。需要說明的是，本場戰事的記載相當有限，主要見於《中國戰典》所引舊聞與《宋史》相關列傳，圍城日數、兵力與結局細節諸說並存；以上只寫可以確定的骨架，不替殘缺之處添上確數。
resultEn: The affair closed in three stages. In the eleventh month of 1127 the rebels besieged Shouchun for twenty-five days, could not take it, and withdrew; the siege decided nothing. The court then changed to amnesty, Zong Ze took the host into his command, gave it the post of 'outer patrol of the four quarters of the capital', and quartered the men at Dongjing, so that the rising was over in appearance. In the seventh month of 1128 Zong Ze died; the rebels rose in the ninth month and moved into western Huai; in October Liu Zhengyan and Liu Yan led three thousand picked troops with eight hundred horsemen into western Huai, spread false banners of five colours, forced a surrender, and after it distributed the men among the various units, and the attack was settled. In the second month of 1129 Ding Jin asked to lead his men back across the Huai to fight the Jin with their blood; the court suspected a new rising, and Wang Yuan at Zhenjiang sent the junior officer Zhang Qing with fifty horsemen to lure him out and behead him. The chief was executed, the remainder were either enrolled or scattered, and the Huai rising that had run for more than two years was at last over. It should be said that the record of this war is thin, resting mainly on older accounts cited in the Zhongguo Zhandian and on the relevant biographies of the Song History; the length of the siege, the numbers and the details of the ending are much contested. What is written above is only the frame that can be established, with no exact figures invented for the gaps.
